author: National Geographic
description:
What does it take to bring down the Mob? In this special compilation episode of Inside the American Mob, travel back to 1983 when Rudolph "Rudy" Giuliani, the US Attorney for the Southern District of New York and future mayor of New York City, sets out to take down the Mafia Commission in New York. Meanwhile, in Las Vegas, Operation Strawman, a multi-year effort by the FBI and US Department of Justice, aims to end the mafia's silent control of Las Vegas casinos.

author: National Geographic
description:
How much do we know about the oceans? They cover 70% of Planet Earth, but there is still much to be discovered about all five oceans and the creatures that call them home. Through the National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Ocean Expeditions, scientists are exploring each one. In the Southern Ocean, research is underway to explore Antarctica's depths and the life in sea ice. In the Pacific Ocean, researchers are tracking blue whales and testing coral's heat limits. Off the coast of the Seychelles in the Indian Ocean, scientists are filming deep-sea creatures, and in the Atlantic Ocean, efforts are underway to protect coasts with mangroves. Finally, scientists in the Arctic Ocean are working with indigenous groups to map the Arctic seafloor. 

This was part of the National Geographic and Rolex Perpetual Planet Southern Ocean Expedition conducted in collaboration with the Schmidt Ocean Institute aboard their research vessel Falkor (too).
